column2: [intro]
In my head, it's all a mess,
Every day, I just navigate this stress,
Between seriousness and absurdity,
It's true, it's all about context, you see?
It's really all about context,
It changes everything, it’s a complex effect,
You can laugh or stay perplexed,
For life is surprising, here's the text!
This morning, I wore my finest dress,
But on the subway, I stepped in mud, no less,
Everyone’s laughing, I look like a fool,
It’s true, it’s all about context, isn’t it cool!
It’s really all about context,
It changes everything, it’s a complex effect,
You can laugh or stay perplexed,
For life is surprising, here's the text!
[ solo ]
So, don’t take it all too seriously,
Laugh and have fun, it’s the key to being free,
Life is a grand journey, a vast comedy,
And in this context, let’s all be artists, you see!
[outro]
